Master’s research internship at Université Gustave Eiffel / IGN, LASTIG, on visual geolocalization combining multimodal language models and 3D LiDAR data. Extend the G3 pipeline, explore 3D foundation models and evaluate on historical aerial images and national LiDAR scans. Six months beginning in the first quarter of 2027, in the Paris area. Requires Master’s or final-year engineering studies, computer vision/deep learning and Python. Apply before 15 December 2026 with CV, motivation letter, references, transcripts and course list. Contacts: Valérie Gouet-Brunet and Florent Le Clerc.
